I5.quote: This study highlights the significant benefits of incorporating activated carbon (AC) into HKUST-1 matrix to reduce its hydrophilic nature while enhancing its hydrogen storage and release capacities.

notes: Pure commercial activated carbon MSC-30 (Kansai Coke) is a measured carbon sorbent: excess H2 isotherm to 140 bar at 77 K on an HPVA II manometric (volumetric) instrument, 5.8 wt% at 77 K and 25 bar (SI Table S2). BET areas of the AC are given by N2 (3030 m2/g) and Ar (2830 m2/g) in SI Table S1.
